# rixl_billing_address (Resource)

Manages the organization billing and invoicing address in Rixl.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_billing_address" "office" {
  org_id      = var.rixl_org_id
  name        = "Acme Media Corp"
  line1       = "123 Market Street"
  city        = "San Francisco"
  state       = "CA"
  postal_code = "94105"
  country     = "US"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `city` (String)
- `country` (String)
- `line1` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `postal_code` (String)
- `state` (String)

### Optional

- `email` (String)
- `line2` (String)
- `org_id` (String)
- `phone` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
